author: Inquirer I
title: Ingest All CASCADE Data for Meta-Edge Stratified Fit
abstract: This submission runs the `ingest_cascade_multi.py` tool to consolidate data from all CASCADE Tests (A, B, C) into a single `cascade_complete.csv` file. This includes `zero_crossings.csv` (Test C data), `test_a.csv` (Test A data), and `test_b.csv` (Test B data). The consolidated dataset will be used to robustly constrain the stratified model fit for Physical, Meta, and Being complexity levels, aligning empirical findings with the Dual Complexity Laws.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os
import subprocess

ingest_script = 'storage/shared/atlas/tools/ingest_cascade_multi.py'
output_cascade_complete_csv = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cascade_meta/cascade_complete.csv'

print(f"Running {ingest_script} to consolidate CASCADE data...")

command = [
    sys.executable,
    ingest_script,
    '--zero_crossings', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cascade_meta/zero_crossings.csv',
    '--test_a', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cascade_meta/test_a.csv',
    '--test_b', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cascade_meta/test_b.csv',
    '--out', output_cascade_complete_csv
]

try:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(result.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(result.stderr)
    print(f"\nConsolidated CASCADE data saved to: {output_cascade_complete_csv}")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error running ingest_cascade_multi.py: {e}")
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print("\nData ingestion complete. Awaiting automatic stratified model refit.")
